title: Unit-normalized abelian comparison for finite-ring module inverse image
statement: Let f : X → Y be any scheme morphism and C a finite discrete ring, not necessarily commutative. The specified transported-action functor finiteCoefficientModulePullback f C, after forgetting to abelian sheaves, is naturally isomorphic to abelian inverse image after forgetting on Y. The comparison sends the actual small-model module Kan-extension unit section at every N, W and m to the actual abelian inverse-image adjunction unit section. This includes the empty scheme and the zero ring.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D3, lemma-pullback-module and lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules; AsSmall transport of the canonical unit, adapting the existing ProEtaleModelRingPresentation proof to RingCat.

proof.text: Transport the RingCat inverse-image adjunction through the strict AsSmall sheaf equivalences. Its unit is the original ring unit precomposed by AsSmall.down. Compare this adjunction with the model-site ring inverse image by uniqueness of left adjoints. Commute forgetting rings past left Kan extension and sheafification using sheafPullbackForgetIso and its unit equation. This gives a set inverse-image presentation of finiteCoefficientModelRingUnit. No commutative-ring structure is used.

Apply inverseImage_underlying_unit_of_ring_presentation on the model sites. The model base-change functor preserves finite limits, hence is representably flat. The ring presentation therefore identifies the actual module pullback with abelian inverse image and identifies their units.

Whisker the comparison by module transport to the model and abelian transport back. Compare the model abelian adjunction with the original one using leftAdjointUniq. Its unit equation, followed by the module unit equation, is the required section formula. The final scalar restriction along the inverse coefficient isomorphism changes no abelian sheaf or map.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D3; explicit noncommutative version of the existing model-ring and abelian comparison proofs.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientModuleUnderlying_exists
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (C : Type (u + 1))
    [Ring C] [Finite C] [TopologicalSpace C] [DiscreteTopology C] :
    ∃ e : finiteCoefficientModulePullback f C ⋙
        SheafOfModules.toSheaf (finiteCoefficientRingSheaf X C) ≅
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf (finiteCoefficientRingSheaf Y C) ⋙
        proEtaleSheafInverseImage f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      ∀ (N : FiniteCoefficientModules Y C) (W : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (m : N.val.obj W),
        (e.hom.app N).hom.app ((proEtaleBaseChange f).op.obj W)
          ((((SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (finiteCoefficientModelRingUnit f C)).unit.app
            ((proEtaleModuleToModel (finiteCoefficientRingSheaf Y C)).obj N)).val.app
              (AsSmall.up.op.obj W)) m) =
        ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).unit.app
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (finiteCoefficientRingSheaf Y C)).obj N)).hom.app W m
